description:
One judgement per case, in a single call.

Batched because a session per leak would mean 234 sessions to clear twelve
papers. Each case carries its own value, field and context, and the index
is echoed back so a misaligned answer is caught rather than silently
attached to the wrong leak.
title: LeakBatch
